messages:
Sam (Partnerships): Quick win — LuminaOps just closed a co-sell + DigitalOcean Marketplace listing for their StoreLens app built on Redwood Private with on-prem connectors. They signed a 2yr Private contract and will let us publish a customer case study next quarter. :tada:
Elaine (CS): Huge — initial telemetry shows ~42% lower p95 after switching to our quantization profile + prefix caching. Customer quote: "Responses felt instantaneous on mobile." I can share the metric deck this afternoon.
Mohit (Sales): Amazing work. Motion details: pilot to 150 stores in Q2, potential ARR ~ $1.1M if rollout goes as planned. I'll sync the AE + renewals team.
Jordan (Product): Nice — can we capture the exact rollout config for the case study (model, quant, autoscale, routing)? Also want to highlight the fallback policy we set for region outages. @devops please save helm values.
Riley (Eng-Infra): Pushing config to the partner repo now, will tag the commit. Snippet of what we used for StoreLens prod: 
```
model: starlight-7b
quant: ff4-int8
batch_window_ms: 12
autoscale:
  min: 4
  max: 24
routing_policy: "latency-first"
cache: prefix_kv: true
```
Riley (Eng-Infra): ops-bot:deploy annotated the listing and created the marketplace bundle.
ops-bot: Marketplace listing published -> https://marketplace.digitalocean.com/apps/luminaops-storelens :white_check_mark:
Elaine (CS): Case study plan: short metric deck + 1-page narrative + 30s customer quote video. Need marketing for copy and screenshots; will collect screenshots this week.
Alex (Marketing): On it — will draft the copy and a quick visual brief by Monday. Can we get screenshots of the Console per-route latency and the customer storefront?
Sam (Partnerships): Shoutout to Elaine, Riley, and Alex for moving fast. Will add to the win board and drop a note in the weekly all-hands. :rocket:
